What if you used your phone on the toilet every day?
Surveys suggest more than half of people take their phone into the bathroom. It's how a lot of people pass the time. People who bring their phone often sit several minutes longer without noticing.

But here's the twist. Sitting longer puts extra pressure on the veins down there and can raise your risk of hemorrhoids, and every flush can spray tiny germs around! Doctors suggest leaving the phone outside and getting up after about five minutes.
